---
name: Feature request
about: Suggest an idea for KnightForge
title: "[Feature] "
labels: enhancement
assignees: ""
---

**Is your feature request related to a problem?**
A clear description of the problem, e.g. "I'm always frustrated when […]".

**Describe the solution you'd like**
What you want to happen.

**Describe alternatives you've considered**
Other chess platforms or workarounds you've tried, and why they don't fit.

**Which area does this touch?**
- [ ] Play (multiplayer / bots / rooms)
- [ ] Analysis / game review
- [ ] Puzzles / Learn / Openings
- [ ] Accounts / Profile
- [ ] Leaderboard / Stats
- [ ] Infrastructure / Deployment

**Keep-it-free check**
KnightForge's core features must remain free and self-hostable on free tiers.
Does your proposal require paid services?

- [ ] No, it can run on the existing free-tier stack.
- [ ] Yes, but it could be an optional add-on.

**Additional context**
Mockups, diagrams, or references welcome.
